scope: R3 local constitutive evaluation, fixed-coefficient material-point memory and a one-dimensional nonlocal length operator; NOT R4 thermal/Stokes solution

primary_sources.title: A community benchmark for viscoplastic thermal convection in a 2-D square box
primary_sources.used: Full main-paper model/benchmark methods; equations 1-11 and Table 1 (printed pages 2176-2179). PDF equations/table visually inspected.
primary_sources.access: Publisher PDF read through research tool on 2026-09-19; no local PDF byte/hash claimed.
primary_sources.not_obtained_or_not_used: Supplementary numerical convection tables are not used; no Nu/RMS/stagnant/mobile/periodic-flow benchmark result is claimed by R3.

primary_sources.title: Generation of Evolving Plate Boundaries and Toroidal Flow From Visco-Plastic Damage-Rheology Mantle Convection and Continents
primary_sources.used: Full article theoretical/numerical methods section 2.3, equations 6-8, Table 1/model19 and associated notes; Appendix A supplementary discussion.
primary_sources.access: Publisher full text including in-article Appendix A read on 2026-09-19; no publication PDF or CitcomS code is redistributed.
primary_sources.not_reproduced: Spherical convection, asthenosphere/melt masks, continental rafts, empirical 0.1 time rescaling, unspecified exact viscosity clipping bounds or published plate/velocity spectra.

primary_sources.purpose: Check thermal density/gravity convention against an actual benchmark implementation, not copy code or benchmark performance.
primary_sources.source_identity: Git blob IDs from the primary repository; files inspected, not redistributed.
primary_sources.observation: The material model reduces density for warming; vertical gravity has a negative final Cartesian component. This agrees with the Atlas rho_anomaly*g convention.

equations.tosi_zero_rate: For positive sigma_Y, eta tends to 2*eta_lin. No invented positive strain-rate floor. For zero sigma_Y the plastic viscosity is eta_star, including the zero-rate limit.
equations.bf23: eta_T=eta0*exp(E/(T+1)-E/2); sigma_y=(a+b*z)*(1-Gamma*min(d,dcrit)/dcrit); eta=min(eta_T,sigma_y/(2*eII)). At eII=0 select eta_T.
equations.memory: Dd/Dt=eII-h(T)*d; h=B*exp(-Ed/(T+1)+Ed/2); B is a rate, not a time. Stored d is NOT clipped at dcrit.
equations.memory_integrator: Exact constant-T/constant-rate update using expm1; not an exact variable-coefficient or advective evolution method.
equations.density: rho_anomaly=-rho0*alpha*(T_K-Tref_K)+delta_rho*C; force=rho_anomaly*gravity_vector; rho0 remains the heat-capacity reference.
equations.heat: q=-k*grad(T_K); Q=Q_internal plus explicitly selected viscous dissipation once. No pressure/adiabatic/latent heat in the frozen Boussinesq reference.

scales.length: Diffusive length L is explicit, not implicitly planet radius or layer thickness.
scales.source_interpretation: BF model19 is registered as a local dimensionless law subset. No unique Earth SI scaling is inferred from its paper or the R2 room-temperature catalogue.

frozen_solver_contract_for_R4.PDE: div u=0; -grad p+div(2 eta e)+rho_anomaly*g=0; rho0 cp DT/Dt=div(k grad T)+Q; DC/Dt=0
frozen_solver_contract_for_R4.pressure: Dynamic pressure only with a zero-mean gauge in the closed box; hydrostatic reference already removed. The gauge is an explicit Atlas choice; ASPECT example uses zero surface average. Gauge-invariant velocity comparisons are distinct from pressure comparisons.
frozen_solver_contract_for_R4.coordinates: Cartesian x horizontal, y upward; z depth downward. Gravity supplied as a vector; no longitude or vertical sign guessed.
frozen_solver_contract_for_R4.first_case: Tosi unit square, constant viscosity verification followed by published variable/viscoplastic cases.
frozen_solver_contract_for_R4.mechanical_boundaries: All four walls impermeable free-slip: u dot n=0, tangential traction=0. No free surface, moving topography or elastic lid.
frozen_solver_contract_for_R4.thermal_boundaries: Ttop=0, Tbottom=1, insulated sidewalls; internal heating H=0 for Tosi.
frozen_solver_contract_for_R4.initial_temperature: T=1-y+0.01*cos(pi*x)*sin(pi*y), as source equation11; NOT evolved here.
frozen_solver_contract_for_R4.composition: Uniform C=0 for the first benchmark. Optional Boussinesq density contrast is an explicit local material coefficient, not a default continental rheology/mixture law.
frozen_solver_contract_for_R4.damage_control: Tosi benchmark has no damage. BF local law is a distinct memory-bearing candidate with Gamma=0 control; not spliced into and called the Tosi benchmark.
frozen_solver_contract_for_R4.heating_control: The BF publication uses internally heated convection; that is recorded context, not silently applied to the Tosi bottom-heated box.
frozen_solver_contract_for_R4.forcing_ownership: Buoyancy is applied once as a body force. No separate slab-pull traction or prescribed plate velocity in this closed benchmark. Future tractions require a separately named case showing non-duplication.
frozen_solver_contract_for_R4.preflight: Initial damage and strain-rate inputs must be explicit. Missing temperatures or pressure-dependent properties are not zeros; absent R4 fields/BCs block a solver run.
frozen_solver_contract_for_R4.printed_momentum_sign_note: Tosi printed eq2 puts +Ra*T*e_y on the right and calls e_y upward. Atlas does not silently copy that sign into its left-side body-force formulation. Its explicit density/gravity convention makes warm buoyancy upward and is checked against ASPECT v3.0.0 benchmark density and gravity definitions. No author-confirmed erratum is claimed. R4 must reconcile its assembled sign/gauge/normalisation before claiming the complete published benchmark.

regularisation.origin: Atlas-declared numerical/model extension, not Becker-Fuchs equation7/8 or a microphysical grain-size law.
regularisation.equation: d_bar - ell^2*d_bar_xx = d with zero normal derivative at endpoints
regularisation.meaning: Strength may consume explicitly selected filtered d_bar; raw d remains retained. ell is a named positive physical length independent of grid spacing.
regularisation.discretisation: Uniform cell-centred 1D finite volume; SPD tridiagonal M-matrix; reusable banded Cholesky.
regularisation.verification: Constant/zero state, positivity, integral, independent dense solve, discrete cosine eigenvalue and continuum second-order refinement.
regularisation.not_accepted: No 2D/3D regularisation, mesh-independent coupled shear-band width or localisation/plate-generation acceptance. These remain mandatory R4/R5 tests, not waived by this operator.

numerical_policy.viscosity_bounds: No default clipping in the local reference presets. Explicit named bounds report floor/ceiling codes; never measured strength or mesh regularisation.
numerical_policy.unknowns: Explicit initial damage required for BF laws. No phase/temperature/pressure/stress law inferred from a reference-density mineral record.
numerical_policy.thresholds: Existing tolerances unchanged. New constitutive tests use independent case-specific round-off bounds; no physics uncertainty inferred from these bounds.

execution.normal: Prepared, native vectorised bulk serial; measured local-law tests did not justify default threading.
execution.parallel: Optional explicit auto/threads policy uses the existing bounded KernelExecutor, global point admission and deterministic ordered assembly. No process mode.
execution.memory: Captured inputs, source context, retained batch outputs and final result bytes admitted. Not a process-RSS cap.
execution.identity: Exact profile+method+runtime/source+input/output bytes; worker count, chunking and timings excluded.
execution.storage: Existing lossless Zstd ArrayStore, self-contained profile/scales/inputs/outputs and original context identity; no fresh store implementation.

bounded_measurements.timing: Complete calls with input capture, source checks, computation, publication/hash. Setup/first call recorded separately. Shared process/library caches, not isolated cold processes.
